## Comparability caveat

One of the five is not on a like-for-like basis with the others. Alaska Air Group's FY2024 includes Hawaiian Airlines only from the September 18, 2024 acquisition date forward — roughly 3.5 months, not a full year: "On September 18, 2024, Alaska Air Group completed its acquisition of Hawaiian Holdings, Inc. ... The results of Hawaiian are included in the consolidated financial statements beginning September 18, 2024. For the period from the acquisition date to December 31, 2024, revenue and net loss from Hawaiian recognized in the Company's consolidated results of operations was $869 million and $113 million, respectively." [DOC-2]. So Alaska's $11,735M of revenue and $395M of net income [DOC-1] represent a partial-year combined entity; on a standalone basis Alaska earned roughly $508M of net income on about $10,866M of revenue. This does not change the ranking at the top, but it means Alaska's figures are not comparable to its own prior years or to a full-year Alaska+Hawaiian entity. All five otherwise report on the same calendar fiscal year (Jan 1 – Dec 31) [DOC-1].

## Ranking

| Airline | Revenue | Operating income | Net income | Net margin |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Delta | $61,643M [DOC-1] | $5,995M [DOC-1] | $3,457M [DOC-1] | 5.6% |
| United | $57,063M [DOC-1] | $5,096M [DOC-1] | $3,149M [DOC-1] | 5.5% |
| American | $54,211M [DOC-1] | $2,614M [DOC-1] | $846M [DOC-1] | 1.6% |
| Alaska | $11,735M [DOC-1] | $570M [DOC-1] | $395M [DOC-1] | 3.4% |
| Southwest | $27,483M [DOC-1] | $321M [DOC-1] | $465M [DOC-1] | 1.7% |

Delta leads on every profitability measure available: largest operating income ($5,995M vs. United's $5,096M) [DOC-1], largest net income ($3,457M vs. United's $3,149M) [DOC-1], and the highest operating margin (~9.7%) and net margin (~5.6%). United is a close second on both absolute dollars and margin. At the other end, Southwest's net income of $465M exceeded its operating income of $321M [DOC-1], implying non-operating income contributed to its bottom line, and American posted the weakest net margin (~1.6%) despite $54.2B of revenue [DOC-1].

ANSWER: Delta Air Lines — the most profitable in FY2024 on both absolute dollars (net income $3,457M; operating income $5,995M) and margin (~5.6% net, ~9.7% operating), with United a close second (net income $3,149M).
